function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

Sure! Here are a few ways you can order a cake, depending on what you’re looking for:

| Option | What it offers | How to order |
|--------|----------------|--------------|
| **Local bakeries** | Fresh, custom‑made cakes, often with seasonal flavors and unique designs. | Search “bakery near me” on Google Maps or Yelp, call the shop, or visit their website. Many bakeries now accept online orders via their own site or through platforms like **Etsy** or **Shopify**. |
| **Online cake delivery services** | Nationwide delivery, a wide range of styles (birthday, wedding, vegan, gluten‑free, etc.). | Popular sites include **Goldbelly**, **Cake Delivery**, **Baker’s Dozen**, and **Amazon Fresh**. Just pick a cake, choose your delivery date, and pay online. |
| **Grocery stores & supermarkets** | Convenient, often with a small selection of ready‑made cakes or “make‑your‑own” kits. | Check the bakery section of stores like **Walmart**, **Kroger**, **Whole Foods**, or local chains. Many have online ordering for pickup or delivery. |
| **Specialty dessert shops** | Gourmet or themed cakes (e.g., chocolate lava, macarons, vegan). | Look for specialty shops in your area or online. Sites like **Martha Stewart Baking** or **The Cake Shop** offer custom orders. |
| **DIY kits** | All the ingredients and instructions delivered to your door. | Order from sites like **Blue Apron**, **HelloFresh**, or **Amazon**. Great if you want to bake yourself but still want a professional look. |

### Quick Tips
1. **Check reviews** – Look at recent ratings on Google, Yelp, or Trustpilot to gauge quality and reliability.
2. **Ask about customization** – If you need a specific design, flavor, or dietary restriction, confirm the baker can accommodate it.
3. **Delivery windows** – Some services only deliver on certain days or times; plan ahead if you need a cake for a specific event.
4. **Payment options** – Most online services accept credit cards, PayPal, or Apple Pay. Local bakeries may also accept mobile payments (Apple Pay, Google Pay).

If you let me know your city or zip code, I can pull up a list of top-rated bakeries or delivery services in your area. Happy cake hunting!
